text: Free demo: a meteor hit your uncle's game store.
Now there are over five thousand game boxes on the floor.
Sort them by genre and platform. PC, Slashstation, Pbox, and Nibnetho.
It's slow and cozy. Pick up, walk, shelve, repeat.
Best moment in the trailer: a bomb blows the pile apart, then a time-lapse fixes the whole store.
The catch? Boxes just pop into perfect slots, so it doesn't feel very hands-on.
The demo is under a gig, in fifteen languages.
Think Supermarket Simulator, but after an asteroid.
Worth a dip, especially if you know those parody consoles.
